packSummary: The 2014 NFL season pack is the archive's first football foundation preview, with real 2014 team context, marquee stars, and a 32-team player pool sized for simulation setup rather than a finished live pack.
featuredStorylines: Brady, Rodgers, Watt, and the Legion of Boom anchor the first football archive tentpole.
The player pool is draft-sized for 32-team football universes with quarterbacks, kickers, DST, and defensive roles included.
Phase 1 keeps schedule, roster snapshots, and games lightweight so the shared simulation shell can open football safely before weekly-engine work lands.

teamSpotlights.summary: Seattle is the focus team: Legion of Boom defense, Russell Wilson mobility, and a Marshawn Lynch power core.
New England provides the Brady-Gronk starting point for modern passing-era builds.
Green Bay adds peak Aaron Rodgers efficiency and a top-tier receiving stack led by Jordy Nelson.
Pittsburgh brings the Bell-Brown fantasy engine and one of the most explosive offensive cores in the pool.
Houston gives the pack a defensive apex with J.J. Watt plus a strong Arian Foster-led offense.
